findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and weakens cryptoperiod controls for audit log data.

No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy that delegates full key access to the account root and thereby to any IAM principal granted kms:* via IAM policies. For a key protecting audit/CloudTrail logs, this permits overly broad decrypt and key-deletion access rather than least privilege.
